claim_as_stated: C (AI on existing workflow) ranks last of four interventions in all 16 processes at base; first only in P03 under optimistic assumptions

discrepancies: 'Ranks last in all 16' is presented as a model result; it is fixed by the parameter cap a<=0.45 plus a free uniform 15% A saving. P07 B vs C is a tie within rounding

Result is an artifact of framing, not evidence
